defensives.name: Enraged Regeneration
defensives.usage_rule: Use reactively when dropping below 50% health to restore a significant amount of HP over 8 seconds.

defensives.name: Rallying Cry
defensives.usage_rule: Use proactively before predictable raid-wide damage spikes to grant your group 15% max health.

defensives.name: Spell Reflection
defensives.usage_rule: Use proactively before targeted magical casts from bosses to reflect or halve incoming spell damage.
